paragraphs.text:
Your  sudden  burst  of  speed  catches  the  sasquatches  by 
surprise. You are faster than them, but your short legs will tire 
before theirs.

Make a CON roll to outdistance the creatures before you have to 
rest. If you succeed, go to 336. If not, you feel a hairy grip upon your 
shoulders—roll 1D10: if the result is even, go to 486; if the result 
is odd, go to 487.
